task_spec: Implement future_value(principal, annual_rate, years, periods_per_year): compound `principal` at `annual_rate` annual interest, compounded `periods_per_year` times a year, for `years` years. future_value(1000, 0.12, 1, 12) should be ~1126.83.

bugs.description: The per-period rate is wrong: it applies the FULL annual_rate every period instead of annual_rate/periods_per_year. The standard formula is principal * (1 + annual_rate/periods_per_year) ** (years*periods_per_year). As written, future_value(1000, 0.12, 1, 12) returns ~3896 (12% compounded 12x = 261% growth) instead of ~1126.83.

provenance.note: subtle bug requiring reasoning/domain knowledge to catch
